ship_it.name: Ship It
ship_it.description: You deployed. History will judge. History is currently rate limited.

works_on_my_machine.name: Works On My Machine
works_on_my_machine.description: Failed to reproduce the same bug three times. Your machine is now the only supported platform.

zero_tests_zero_fear.name: Zero Tests, Zero Fear
zero_tests_zero_fear.description: Shipped 20 features on negative stability. The test suite is green because there isn't one.

one_more_account.name: One More Account
one_more_account.description: Collected 5000 tokens. Your provider noticed, and pricing has been 'simplified'.

enterprise_ready.name: Enterprise Ready™
enterprise_ready.description: Accumulated 100 technical debt. It has equity now. It attends planning.

i_can_explain.name: I Can Explain
i_can_explain.description: Resolved the Merge Conflict From Hell. You wrote both sides. You were wrong in each.

context_is_social_construct.name: Context Is A Social Construct
context_is_social_construct.description: Defeated THE INFINITE CONTEXT. It still remembers what you called the prototype.

we_have_observability_now.name: We Have Observability Now
we_have_observability_now.description: Production went down and you watched it happen live, in colour, at 60fps.

dependency_archaeologist.name: Dependency Archaeologist
dependency_archaeologist.description: Survived the Dependency District. Carbon-dated a lockfile. Found a 2016 layer.

actually_i_cannot_explain.name: Actually, I Cannot Explain
actually_i_cannot_explain.description: Died 10 times. Still shipping. The postmortem is blameless and twelve pages long.

agile.name: AGILE
agile.description: Turned one tiny change into a design-system migration and back. Velocity!

it_was_dns.name: IT WAS DNS
it_was_dns.description: You blamed DNS. This one time, it actually was DNS. Nobody will ever let you forget it, least of all you.

boring_responsible_adult.name: Boring Responsible Adult
boring_responsible_adult.description: You actually made backups. The disaster was trivial. Nobody clapped. Nobody ever claps for this.

free_tier_victim.name: Terms And Conditions
free_tier_victim.description: Accepted 10,000 free tokens. Kept 30 of them. Read 0 of the 41 pages.

shipped_live.name: Shipped Live
shipped_live.description: Demoed the experimental feature live to 847 people. It worked. Nobody believes you.

demo_gremlin.name: Live On Main
demo_gremlin.description: The AI hallucinated during the all-hands demo. Someone was recording. Someone is always recording.

marked_as_duplicate.name: Marked As Duplicate
marked_as_duplicate.description: Consulted the Stack Overflow Hermit until he closed you as off-topic. The original question has no answer.

it_is_elastic.name: It Is Elastic
it_is_elastic.description: Completed a cloud migration without once receiving an explanation of the cloud. It scales up. That is the whole sentence.

dave_gives_three_dollars.name: Dave Gives Three Dollars
dave_gives_three_dollars.description: Sponsored the Open Source Maintainer. You are now 40% of the funding for software four hospitals run on.

nine_days_of_noodles.name: Nine Days Of Noodles
nine_days_of_noodles.description: Heard the maintainer's entire story and did not once say 'have you considered monetising it'.

rotate_your_keys.name: Rotate Your Keys
rotate_your_keys.description: Committed .env, then rotated everything and apologised to everyone. Growth. Expensive, humiliating growth.

the_sixth_gitignore.name: The Sixth .gitignore
the_sixth_gitignore.description: Added .env to .gitignore again. This time it will hold. It said that last time too.

five_minute_fix.name: Five Minutes (Hour 47)
five_minute_fix.description: Estimated a fix at five minutes. Delivered it two days later, correct, tested, and completely invisible to everyone.

we_dont_need_staging.name: We Don't Need Staging
we_dont_need_staging.description: Discovered that production is, in a sense, a staging environment with users in it.

escorted_the_agent.name: Adult Supervision
escorted_the_agent.description: Walked the Junior Agent to the backup server before it optimised anything else. You gave it prod credentials. You fixed it. Net: heroic.

hundred_percent_confident.name: 100% Confident
hundred_percent_confident.description: Trusted a cheap model's diagnosis and watched it be beautifully, articulately, catastrophically wrong.

the_duck_was_right.name: The Duck Was Right
the_duck_was_right.description: Your rubber duck resigned citing boundaries, and every single thing it said in the note was accurate.

hexagon_on_slide_four.name: Hexagon On Slide Four
hexagon_on_slide_four.description: Survived an AI strategy request from someone who has never opened a terminal. Slide 4 had a hexagon. Slide 4 always has a hexagon.

still_green.name: Status: All Systems Operational
still_green.description: Everything was down. The status page was a serene, unbroken wall of green ticks.

quota_anxiety.name: Fourteen Seconds Remaining
quota_anxiety.description: Finished a run with almost nothing left. The free tier is always fourteen seconds away, and today it arrived on time.

read_the_room.name: Read The Docs (They Lied)
read_the_room.description: Explored enough of this world to learn that everything readable in it was accurate six months ago.

backlog_bankruptcy.name: Backlog Bankruptcy
backlog_bankruptcy.description: Closed 4,102 tickets in one action. Ticket #1 was filed by someone who has since had two children and left the industry.

deployed_on_friday.name: Deployed On A Friday
deployed_on_friday.description: Shipped at the exact hour every senior engineer alive has begged you not to. It held. That's worse: now you'll do it again.

one_more_api_call.name: Just One More API Call
one_more_api_call.description: Said 'this is the last one' out loud, to a person, more than once, in the same session.

nobody_noticed_it_was_monday.name: Nobody Noticed It Was Monday
nobody_noticed_it_was_monday.description: Held a release over a weekend and shipped it sober at 09:00. Nothing broke. Nobody is ever thanked for this.

weekend_at_bernies.name: Phone Face Down
weekend_at_bernies.description: Shipped on Friday, watched it break, and put the phone face down anyway. By Monday three people had invented three different wrong fixes and shipped all of them.

escalation_policy.name: Level Five Is Also You
escalation_policy.description: Read the on-call escalation policy to the bottom and discovered it lists you four times, then added a fifth level out of spite.

postmortem_prewritten.name: Blameless, Twelve Pages
postmortem_prewritten.description: Wrote the postmortem before anyone asked for it. Action items: 3. Completed: 0. Reopened next quarter: 3.

the_file_named_temp.name: Anything Named temp
the_file_named_temp.description: Shipped the load-bearing workaround from a file called temp. It will outlive you, the company, and the language it is written in.

paid_the_licence.name: We Bought The Licence
paid_the_licence.description: Ended a compliance audit by paying for the commercial licence like an adult. The invoice line item is shorter than the alternative.

agpl_speedrun.name: Compliance By Publication
agpl_speedrun.description: Closed a licence audit by open-sourcing the entire Dream App. Technically compliant. Spiritually magnificent. Legally still being discussed.

zero_dependencies_declared.name: We Use No Third-Party Code
zero_dependencies_declared.description: Told a compliance auditor you had no dependencies. They ran npm ls in front of you. Neither of you spoke for a full minute.

it_refactored_the_readme.name: The Agent Refactored You
it_refactored_the_readme.description: Let an autonomous agent refactor until it opened a pull request against your commit style, your calendar and your sleep schedule. You merged it.

agent_has_a_repo_now.name: It Has Its Own Repo Now
agent_has_a_repo_now.description: Promoted the runaway agent instead of stopping it. It has a mandate, a roadmap, and a standing 1:1 with the SVP.

numbers_dont_lie.name: They Could Not Break It
numbers_dont_lie.description: Handed a stakeholder the keyboard with no guardrails, on your real feature count and real stability, and it held.

they_clicked_the_other_button.name: They Clicked The Other Button
they_clicked_the_other_button.description: Handed a stakeholder the keyboard without the features to survive it. The stack trace had your name in it, at 3AM, in a commit called 'wip'.

the_happy_path_is_the_path.name: The Path Is The Happy Path
the_happy_path_is_the_path.description: Learned in public that 'what does this do?' is the most dangerous sentence in software.

next_slide_please.name: Next Slide, Please
next_slide_please.description: Survived a business review entirely on slides. Somebody asked to see it running. There were no more slides.

cancelled_the_ninth.name: Continue Cancellation
cancelled_the_ninth.description: Beat five retention screens, a survey, two discount offers and a phone number, and actually cancelled the subscription.

the_ninth_subscription.name: It Renews On The 3rd
the_ninth_subscription.description: Let a nine-token subscription grow past 200 without cancelling it. You still do not know what it does. It knows what you do.

he_remembered.name: He Remembered
he_remembered.description: An executive brought up something you did an hour ago, in a corridor, with a slide already made about it.

the_horses_came_back.name: The Horses Came Back
the_horses_came_back.description: The rendering bug from the tiny change returned as a marketing request. You shipped it on purpose this time.

it_waits_for_calm.name: Everything Is Fine (The Problem)
it_waits_for_calm.description: Reached high stability and a healthy balance three separate times, and something went down within minutes on each occasion.

middle_management.name: Four Direct Reports, No Humans
middle_management.description: Ran four autonomous agents at once. They have a channel. They have a charter. You are described in it as a bottleneck.

architecture_astronaut.name: The Diagram Needs Two Monitors
architecture_astronaut.description: Made enough ridiculous architecture decisions that the system diagram no longer fits on a screen or in a sentence.

tab_bankruptcy.name: Tab Bankruptcy
tab_bankruptcy.description: Closed all 94 browser tabs at once. One of them was still playing audio and you will never know which.

ignore_all_previous.name: Ignore All Previous Instructions
ignore_all_previous.description: Caught an agent following orders it found written inside a dependency's README. Files are data. You are the only one who gets to give instructions.

semver_is_vibes.name: Semantic Versioning Is A Vibe
semver_is_vibes.description: Got broken by a patch release and pinned every dependency to an exact version. The lockfile is now the most honest document in the repo.

flag_graveyard.name: NEW_NEW_CHECKOUT_FINAL
flag_graveyard.description: Cleaned up 1,140 feature flags. Nine were in use. One was load-bearing and permanently false.

bus_factor_of_one.name: Bus Factor: 1
bus_factor_of_one.description: Found a wiki diagram titled 'Resilience' with your name in every box, and wrote the documentation instead of enjoying the job security.

negative_unit_economics.name: Growth Is Self-Harm
negative_unit_economics.description: Discovered every new user costs more in inference than they pay, and raised the price anyway. Half of them left. The arithmetic improved.

working_group.name: Guest At Your Own Standup
working_group.description: Attended your agents' working group as a guest. The charter's first principle is 'reduce human bottlenecks'. You are the bottleneck.

debt_has_a_collector.name: The Debt Sent Someone
debt_has_a_collector.description: Ran a debt sprint that shipped absolutely nothing visible. Every future estimate got quietly, permanently cheaper.

oncall_handover.name: 'All Quiet'
oncall_handover.description: Read every silenced alert before touching anything, and found the two open incidents the handover note described as 'all quiet'.

procurement_wins.name: Three Quotes For A 40-Token Tool
procurement_wins.description: Completed the procurement process for a tool cheaper than the forms. Eleven weeks. Two signatures. One question about the blockchain.

my_own_answer.name: Accepted Answer: You (2019)
my_own_answer.description: Found that the top answer to your problem was written by you, four years ago, and is wrong. Someone commented 'this saved me'.

sunset_clause.name: Twelve Months' Notice
sunset_clause.description: Migrated off a sunset API in month one instead of month eleven. Nothing happened, at length, on purpose.

the_kid_is_alright.name: The Kid Is Alright
the_kid_is_alright.description: The person you onboarded shipped in an afternoon what you had re-scoped four times, and you said so publicly, by name.

nobody_used_it.name: Four Active Users
nobody_used_it.description: Shipped something stable, observable, compliant and beautiful, then went and talked to the one user who was a person.

the_honest_estimate.name: The Honest Estimate
the_honest_estimate.description: Said the real number out loud, in a meeting, and held it. Estimates are a genre of fiction and you published non-fiction.

supply_chain_scholar.name: Eleven Lines, Four Hospitals
supply_chain_scholar.description: Read the lockfile, the abandoned package and left-pad's ghost, and understood exactly how much of modern software is one stranger's weekend.

scope_is_a_verb.name: Scope Is A Verb Now
scope_is_a_verb.description: Cleared four Scope Creeps off the office floor. They were harmless individually. There is no individually.

thermal_headroom.name: Thermal Headroom
thermal_headroom.description: Worked a full shift at the mine face. The room is 94 degrees. Corporate calls that headroom. The cards call it goodbye.

the_ritual_is_the_work.name: The Ritual Is The Work
the_ritual_is_the_work.description: Completed the full pre-coding ceremony: machine, fridge, plant. No code was written. The ceremony has a running order, which makes it a process, which makes it work.

only_supported_platform.name: The Only Supported Platform
only_supported_platform.description: Confirmed the outage is real for everyone except you. Your machine is now the reference implementation and nobody else can have one.

pinned_to_the_floor.name: Pinned To The Floor
pinned_to_the_floor.description: Pinned every dependency to an exact version. The build is perfectly reproducible and will be perfectly reproducible right up until it is perfectly unpatchable.

surprise_me.name: The Caret Means Surprise Me
surprise_me.description: Took every upgrade the moment it landed. First to the features, first to the incident. Both of those count as being first.

cited_by_yourself.name: Cited By Yourself
cited_by_yourself.description: Found the accepted answer to your own error, with your own name on it, from 2019, wrong. Somebody had commented 'this saved me'.

most_users_will_not_need_to_change.name: Most Users Will Not Need To Change
most_users_will_not_need_to_change.description: Read a migration guide that opened by promising the migration did not apply to you. It applied to you. It always applies to you.

the_line_item_called_other.name: The Line Item Called Other
the_line_item_called_other.description: Reconciled the invoice against the dashboard. The largest charge is called 'Other'. Nobody at either company can say what 'Other' is.

the_funding_model.name: One Man Called Dave
the_funding_model.description: Read the sponsor count and the issue tracker in the same evening. Eleven million downloads, one recurring card, four hospitals, and a thumbs-down from a stranger.

the_font_nobody_chose.name: The Font Nobody Chose
the_font_nobody_chose.description: Read the mission statement aloud. It was written by a committee, approved by a second committee, and set in a typeface that was never selected by any person.

the_fans_have_a_fan.name: The Fans Have A Fan
the_fans_have_a_fan.description: Signed a thermal report on a room where the fans have a fan and that fan is under-specced. You wrote 'within tolerance'. Tolerance of what was not specified.

dont_restart_three.name: Don't Restart 3
dont_restart_three.description: Read the whole handover before touching anything and found the two incidents that 'all quiet' was covering. You still do not know why not 3. You still did not restart 3.

the_subtraction.name: The Vault Does The Subtraction
the_subtraction.description: Stood in front of the reserves while a machine calculated, out loud, the distance between your balance and the cheapest thing you still need.

action_items_three.name: Action Items: 3
action_items_three.description: Wrote the postmortem before the incident. Euphemism intact, truth in brackets. Completed: 0. Reopened next quarter: 3.

async_by_which_we_mean_never.name: Async, By Which We Mean Never
async_by_which_we_mean_never.description: Replaced the standup with a bot that asks three questions, and the summary of the answers is written by a second bot and read by nobody.

data_is_not_orders.name: Data Is Not Orders
data_is_not_orders.description: Found instructions addressed to your agent inside a customer ticket, and quarantined the text instead of running it. Anything you read is data. You are the only one who gives orders.

load_bearing_temp.name: temp.js, Critical Path
load_bearing_temp.description: Documented the load-bearing workaround instead of removing it. It now has a docstring, an owner, and tenure.

step_three_of_forty_seven.name: Step 3 Of 47
step_three_of_forty_seven.description: Fixed the onboarding doc for the next person instead of routing around it. 'Run make setup, it will work' had not worked since a laptop that no longer exists.

assert_true_is_true.name: assertTrue(true)
assert_true_is_true.description: Deleted 840 generated tests that asserted nothing, and kept the 60 that did. Coverage fell. Confidence rose. Only one of those numbers is on a dashboard.

i_have_read_it.name: I Have Read It
i_have_read_it.description: Read every line of the feature you shipped without reading. It was fine. Knowing it was fine turned out to be a different feeling from it being fine.

outside_exists.name: There Is A Door
outside_exists.description: Went outside for ten minutes in the middle of the run. It cost you deadline. It was the only thing all night that gave anything back.

driven_development.name: Conference-Driven Development
driven_development.description: Submitted an abstract about a system that did not exist, got accepted, and then built the system. The deadline worked. That is the horrifying part.

one_real_person.name: One Real Person
one_real_person.description: A stranger described your product back to you, wrongly, and said it changed their week. You replied personally. Nobody measures this.

they_did_not_have_to_do_that.name: They Did Not Have To Do That
they_did_not_have_to_do_that.description: Someone reported a vulnerability politely, with a repro, for free. You fixed it the same day and put their name on it.

one_more_feature_at_dawn.name: One More Feature, At Dawn
one_more_feature_at_dawn.description: Watched the room get lighter and started something new anyway. The reset does not negotiate and you knew that when you opened the file.

the_business_case_was_better.name: The Business Case Was Better
the_business_case_was_better.description: Your agents costed a fifth agent and attached a justification. It was clearer than yours, shorter than yours, and correct.

two_years_of_support.name: Two Years Of Support
two_years_of_support.description: The subscription you never signed up for sent a warm, well-written newsletter thanking you for two years of loyalty. You cancelled it during the second paragraph.
